stop_reason: No exercise contrast: every sequenced sample is a sedentary gastrocnemius from WT or SPAG7 KO mice (only factor genotype, 5 WT / 4 KO). The paper's exercise data are treadmill endurance phenotypes (S2.3.p1, S4.12.p1), not sequenced conditions, so an exercise effect on gene expression cannot be identified. Relabelling the KO-vs-WT genotype contrast as an exercise effect would change the estimand.
